## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) and VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) ↓ falling confirm fear easing, while HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) and LQD (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND show mixed credit signals versus the regime-level HYG/LQD flag.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) ↓ falling; Credit mixed: HYG/LQD showing small gains (HYG ABOVE TREND | LQD ABOVE TREND) but the system flagged CREDIT STRESS ↑. Stocks vs Bonds rising: SPY/TLT RECOVERY (ratio 1W: +1.48%) ↑ rising supports risk-on tilt.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing: UUP RECOVERY (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.22%) ↑ rising while TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) → flat; yield curve CORRECTION (flat) — conditions support risk taking but monitor liquidity/credit signals.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and energy leadership: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +7.69%) showing strength, while XLK RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) lags on the month; style: cyclicals/value favored versus growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally stronger: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) shows EM catch-up; EWJ CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +7.89%) and FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.35%) highlight regional dispersion.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Spec risk mixed: IWM RECOVERY (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -1.19%) and ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%) show short-term rallies, while IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) signals continued concentrated volatility.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious & industrial metals mixed: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) rising; SLV RECOVERY (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) is a high-volatility short-term bounce.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: broad sector breadth (9/11) and falling VXX provide two independent confirmations for RISK-ON. Divergence: MAJOR short-term mismatches (QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -1.21%), XLK RECOVERY, IWM RECOVERY) plus a flagged credit-stress signal — momentum is uneven.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and energy exposure: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%); reduce exposure to high-volatility/structurally weak trades like UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) and monitor credit indicators (HYG/LQD).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) — watch oil follow-through; Industrials XLI/XLB (XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%)) for cyclical breadth.  
BEARISH: Staples XLP CORRECTION (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +7.44%) and Materials showing recent weakness XME/Materials BELOW TREND signal potential mean reversion.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent/BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) — energy strength to watch.  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) — downside persistence likely.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency/checkpoint); HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF spread ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot); SPY short-term support ~current 1M level (monitor SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%)).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, supported by SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) and VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) ↓ falling. Energy and cyclicals showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%)). Key risk: mixed credit signal and short-term recovery divergences across tech/cap ETFs (XLK RECOVERY, QQQ RECOVERY, IWM RECOVERY) to monitor.
